evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown that increased inference-time reasoning can improve performance on complex tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Using tool-decision latency, token consumption, token-limit exhaustion, and answer correctness, our results suggest that cases classified as over-reasoning are associated with higher computational cost without proportional accuracy gains, whereas cases classified as under-reasoning are consistently associated with incorrect or incomplete solutions.
